Zoe (eng-ml): Quick follow-up from the eviction pattern postmortem. We need concrete eval additions: regression tests, promptset, load profiles, and a chaos drill. Can we nominate owners and deadlines?
Ravi (eng-sre): I'll take the chaos drill + runbook updates. Plan: simulate gradual KV degradation + intermittent OOM on staging. Target date: Thu 09:30am. Need a small driver script and abort criteria.
Hannah (eng-platform): I'll own infra jobs and canary monitors. I'll add a nightly canary that runs the new regression matrix and a PR smoke. Will provision a 3xA100 staging cluster for 6 hours.
Miguel (eng-ml): I'll own regression tests and promptset. Proposed matrix: seq_len=[128,512,2048], batch=[1,16], kernel=[fp16,int8], cache_state=[cold,warm]. ETA: PR by Wed EOD.
Zoe (eng-ml): Include edge prompts: long-reference chains and repeated short tokens that previously caused eviction spikes. Add flag `--detect-fallback` to assert kernel fallback events.
Miguel (eng-ml): Example test runner I'll put in PR: `./ci/run_regression --case=burst_write --seq=2048 --kernel=int8 --check-fallback`
Ravi (eng-sre): For the chaos driver I need `tools/induce_kv_degrade --pct=25 --ramp=90` and an abort if error_rate > 0.5% sustained. I will add triage signals: KV miss rate, cache_eviction_rate, tail latency p99.
Hannah (eng-platform): I'll wire the metric `runtime.kernel_fallback_count{kernel="int8"}` to the canary dashboard and add an alert rule: p95 latency delta > 20% for 5m.
Zoe (eng-ml): Ownership summary pls: Miguel=regression+promptset (Wed), Ravi=chaos+runbook (Thu), Hannah=infra+canary (Wed). I'll update the postmortem action tracker with PR links and infra ticket.
Miguel (eng-ml): Adding int8 rounding modes and qat toggle to the matrix as a risk axis.
OpsBot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/pm/eviction-patterns  action_items: 3 assigned.
Hannah (eng-platform): Provisioned staging ticket: STG-5502 and CI job `nightly/eviction-harness`. Posting job URL in tracker.
Ravi (eng-sre): Scheduled chaos drill Thu 09:30am, tagging on-call, drill runner will use the provided driver and run for 5m with safe abort guards.
Zoe (eng-ml): We'll do a Monday morning check to confirm PR status and overnight canary results. Close items after 48h of clean nightly runs.
Miguel (eng-ml): PR draft uploaded and promptset linked in tracker: https://redwood/pr/eviction-harness
Zoe (eng-ml): Thanks team. If any infra blockers ping Hannah; otherwise mark items "in progress" in the tracker.
